grounding.observed: E1 inputs check out: metadata.json has net_charge_per_molecule 0.0, n_molecules 250, density 0.3; the zero-step CPU read_data log shows 11250 atoms and no ERROR line. The builder log is empty, so its exit code was never recorded. None of the box outputs were found: no equilibration density file, no Performance line for prod_a, prod_b or prod_c, and no install log. So the ns/day figure (claimed proxy 250, gate >=150) and the USD 941 re-pricing cannot be re-derived.
grounding.note: Only pre-launch artifacts exist in out/. The A100 run outputs for E2 to E8 (density file, Performance lines, thermo logs) were never saved, and the builder exit code is not recorded, so E1 is only partly checkable.

findings.confound: decidability by construction (forced or impossible endpoint, or endpoint answering a different question than the seed)
findings.crux: Every endpoint has a pre-named, reachable refuting outcome (E3 [100,625], E3b >=150, E3c cap at 235.3, E2 +/-4%), so nothing is forced. But the gate reading is conditional on E1, E2, E6 and E8 passing, and no committed number says which branch occurs. An E6 refusal swaps the protocol to viscosity-only.

findings.confound: Unit/scale: ns/day depends on the deck's timestep units and on which run's Performance line is read; a constant factor error would shift every E3-E5 cell together. Layers/strengths are N/A.
findings.crux: No measured number exists yet. Whether the Performance-line ns/day equals steps*2fs/wall-clock (correct timestep units and correct run segment) is not established. The thresholds themselves are discriminating (E3 [100,625], gate 150, cap 235.3), so the design is not degenerate by construction.
